text:
sre-bot: PAGER — P0: High rate of websocket disconnects from enterprise tenant AcmeCorp via VPC Gateway (edge 504 + ECONNRESET). Streaming sessions dropping, retries surging, ded pool CPU at 92%. Alert: https://internal.alerts/INC-1918204567 :rotating_light:

oncall_dmitri: grabbing it, logging in now. any customer-reported outages?

customer-success: yes, Acme reported intermittent stream failures starting ~16:05 UTC, some clients reconnecting repeatedly. They're seeing increased latency then disconnect.

mike_ops: tailing gateway logs — seeing repeated "upstream read timeout" then immediate reconnects from customer gateway. retry_count spikes from 1->6 in seconds.

eng-platform: quick note — this tenant is on a Dedicated pool (dedicated-acme-us-east-1) with quorum isolation. If retries saturating the pool we'll want to either throttle retries at the gateway or fail-open to fallback model variants. Recommend temp route to a low-cost fallback pool to reduce load.

tara: agree. mitigation plan: 1) throttle inbound retries at our gateway (circuit-breaker) 2) increase gateway websocket idle/read timeout to 90s 3) shift some sessions to fallback pool. doing step 1 & 3 now.

alex_r: also check if a recent deploy touched websocket connection handling — deploy-bot, any deploys to gateway around 16:00?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T15:58:41Z to service=redwood-gateway completed by ci-bot. No config changes flagged for tenant routing.

oncall_dmitri: running routing change:```bash
rdrctl route set --tenant acme --pool dedicated-fallback-2 --region us-east-1 --mode gradual --weight 30
``` will move 30% of new sessions to fallback. applying now.

mike_ops: saw immediate drop in retry spikes for sessions routed to fallback. CPU on dedicated-acme down to 64% after ~90s. reconnects reduced for those sessions.

customer-success: pinging Acme with interim guidance: recommend clients backoff with jitter, bump socket-level timeout to 120s while we stabilize.

eng-platform: enabled circuit-breaker rule for tenant acme (max-consecutive-retries=3, backoff=exponential, base=500ms). config snippet:```json
{"tenant":"acme","circuit_breaker":{"max_retries":3,"base_backoff_ms":500,"max_backoff_ms":10000}}
```

oncall_dmitri: increased gateway read timeout to 90s on us-east edge. note: this may slightly increase latency for hung streams but prevents premature disconnects.

tara: monitoring metrics: error-rate down 72% vs peak, token throughput stable. still seeing a small population of sessions that get ECONNRESET ~once every 10m. rolling log capture to eng-runtime for KV cache examine.

alex_r: handing off to eng-platform for follow-up and postmortem. summary note for handoff: root cause unknown — likely client retry storm amplified by small timing window + edge timeout config. mitigations applied: throttled retries, moved 30% to fallback pool, increased timeouts. please follow up with telemetry, & check if kernel-level socket Shininess from recent infra deploy contributed.

eng-platform: taking over. I'll collect more traces (tcpdump + gateway traces) and coordinate with runtime team. tagging @eng-runtime and will set up a 1-hour war room if regressions return.

customer-success: Acme confirmed partial relief; some long-lived streams still failing but overall UX improved. they asked for a formal RCA and ETA for a permanent fix.

oncall_dmitri: leaving a short incident log in pager duty, will prepare a timeline. handing pager to alex_r for the next shift. :point_right: alex_r please ack and own postmortem.

alex_r: acked. I'll take ownership and schedule a postmortem with eng-platform + customer-success + runtime. will draft impact statement for CS to share with Acme.

mike_ops: putting the temporary route rollback command here in case we need to revert quickly:```bash
rdrctl route set --tenant acme --pool dedicated-acme-us-east-1 --mode immediate --weight 100
```

oncall_dmitri: thanks team, leaving notes in incident doc. tagging for follow-ups: :memo: @eng-platform @eng-runtime @customer-success. closing pager for now, keep monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied, impact reduced. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update expected within 30m or on-change.
